reference_replay.scope: Sum of the current successful per-module receipts, including earlier pilot and presentation runs. Reused Mettapedia and Mathlib dependencies are outside this sum.

private_assembly_gate.memory_scope: No per-module RSS measurement in this final driver; reference measurements are separate.

portable_assembly_gate.memory_scope: No per-module RSS measurement in this final driver; reference measurements are separate.

source_construction_scope: Exact source geometry and compatible GSLT witnesses for every bridgeless spherical cubic source map and every complete valid vertex sweep.
plane_graph_scope: Finite simple graphs in any universe with actual noncrossing path drawings; empty, disconnected and isolated-vertex cases included.
limitations: The proof uses the classical unavoidable catalogue; it does not prove the original bounded-width or hexagonal-bulk proposals.
Kempe-compatible witnesses use classical choice; no executable Kempe-move sequence is extracted.
Original-data/decoder isomorphism comparisons remain program evidence; the theorem consumes the pinned Lean decoder and its proved soundness.
